subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 / Pen test report + vuln management process
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 / Pen test report + vuln mgmt (next steps)

Hi John,

Thanks again for your time earlier — great conversation and appreciate the context on the platform and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security items you mentioned: 

- SOC 2: You asked whether Redwood has SOC 2 Type II. We have an in-progress Type II (control testing scheduled in Q3 2026); we can share the most recent Type I report now and provide an expected Type II delivery date.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR controls across our hosted and private offerings. For HIPAA, we offer a BAA for Dedicated/Private customers — happy to connect legal if you need that.
- Vendor security questionnaire: I attached our vendor security questionnaire for FinTechCo to fill out (or you can point me to your standard doc).
- Pen test / vuln management: You asked for our most recent pen test report and our vuln SLA/scanning cadence. To be transparent, we typically share a redacted pen test report under NDA and provide a high-level executive summary publicly. Our vuln management process is detailed below and we can formalize it in writing.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you can share your vendor security questionnaire, I’ll loop in our Security team to provide answers (or see attached if you prefer we fill it out).
2) If FinTechCo is OK with an NDA, we’ll share a redacted pen-test report (and can provide an executive summary without an NDA).
3) We’ll send a written summary of our vuln management SLA and scanning cadence (see initial details below).

Initial vuln management details (summary):
- Scanning cadence: internal automated SAST/DAST and dependency scans run daily; authenticated external scans and scheduled third-party pen tests run quarterly for production endpoints (annual full-scope by a third-party, with targeted external scans quarterly; frequency can be adjusted for enterprise customers).
- Triage / SLAs: Critical: 72 hours to mitigation plan and 7 days to patch where feasible; High: 7-14 days to mitigation plan; Medium: 30 days; Low: next scheduled release.
- Disclosure: Coordinated disclosure via security@redwood.com; we share impact, remediation plan, and expected timelines.

I’ve CC’d Rishi (security) and Monica (AE) who will help with specifics. Attaching: vendor-security-questionnaire-FinTechCo.xlsx and a short pen-test-request-form to capture scope if you’d like us to initiate.

Availability: happy to jump on a 15-min call with your security team this week if useful.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 / Pen test report + vuln mgmt (next steps)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the follow-up and the questionnaire. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) SOC 2: FinTechCo requires SOC 2 Type II for any hosted vendors. Type I is helpful but not sufficient for our procurement — can you confirm the expected delivery month for Type II?

2) Pen test report: We need to review Redwood's most recent third-party penetration test report (redacted is fine) and the summary of open findings and remediation timelines. Is that something you can share under an NDA or a secure link?

3) Vulnerability SLAs: Are the SLAs you mentioned contractual (SLA-backed) for enterprise customers, or are these internal targets? For critical findings we typically require a response plan within 48–72 hours and visible progress updates until closure.

4) HIPAA: We are evaluating both PCI and HIPAA implications; can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA for hosted (SaaS) customers or only for Dedicated/Private deployments?

I can send over FinTechCo’s standard vendor security questionnaire if that’s easier — attaching it here. Let me know if you prefer an NDA first and I’ll get that started.

Best,
John
Head of Security, FinTechCo
john.doe@fintechco.com

Team — forwarding John’s response. He’s explicit that FinTechCo requires SOC 2 Type II and wants the redacted pen test report + open findings/remediation timelines. He also asked whether our SLAs are contractual for enterprise customers and whether we’ll sign a BAA for hosted.

Can you help with the following:
- Rishi: draft a short executive summary we can send that includes our current Type II timeline, a one-page vuln mgmt SLA (contractual language options), and guidance on sharing the redacted pen test report (NDA vs executive summary).
- Dylan: confirm scanning cadence and whether we can commit to a quarterly external scan + annual full third-party test for our Hosted offering; also confirm typical remediation timelines and escalation process.

I’ve attached the redacted 2025 pen test report we can share under NDA (redwood-pen-test-report-2025-redacted.pdf). If we need additional redaction / legal approval, flag it here.

Thanks — Marissa

Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 / Pen test report + vuln mgmt (next steps)

Hi John — following up with the information we discussed. Apologies for the short delay — I wanted to confirm details with Security and Infra.

1) SOC 2: We expect to complete SOC 2 Type II control testing in Q3 2026 and have a target publication date of 2026-10-15. We can share the most recent Type I report now; if FinTechCo requires Type II before contract signature, we’re open to conditional language in the MSA or a short-term attestation.

2) Pen test report: Attached is a redacted copy of our most recent third-party pen test (redwood-pen-test-report-2025-redacted.pdf). Per our standard practice, we provide the redacted report under NDA; if you’re able to sign an NDA we can share additional detail and the full findings with remediation notes. If an NDA is slower, we can also provide an expanded executive summary now.

3) Vulnerability management & SLAs (Executive summary):
- Scanning cadence: daily automated SCA/SAST/DAST for code and dependencies; authenticated external scans weekly for high-traffic production endpoints; full external scans quarterly; third-party pen tests annually (scoped by deployment). For enterprise customers we can increase external scan cadence to quarterly/continuous per contract.
- Triage & SLA: Critical (RCE, active exploit): 72 hours to mitigation plan + 7 days to deploy workaround/patch where feasible; High: 7–14 days to mitigation plan; Medium: 30 days; Low: next scheduled release. For Dedicated/Private customers we offer contractual SLAs as part of enterprise terms (we’re happy to add explicit remediation timelines to the MSA).
- Disclosure: Coordinated disclosure is handled via security@redwood.com — we notify impacted customers, provide severity, remediation status, and ETA. We can provide a customer-facing incident playbook as part of the enterprise onboarding packet.

4) HIPAA / BAA: We can sign a BAA for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted SaaS customers we evaluate BAAs case-by-case; enterprise contracts typically include BAA language for regulated customers.

Next steps I suggest:
- If you can send an NDA, we’ll exchange it and provide the full (redacted) report and the qualified remediation tracker.
- Alternatively, I can send an expanded executive summary and a short SLA excerpt for the MSA this afternoon.

Please let me know which route you prefer. Happy to schedule a quick call between your security team and Rishi/Dylan to walk through the report and process.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
